(optional)"; placeholder "example.com"; hint "We use it to show the right logo. Leave it empty to show your brand's initial."; globe SVG icon; wrapper classes identical to the brand search wrapper (rounded border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2.5, same focus ring). results.title: Brand name typed as an address prefills the website field
results.error: Expected: the website field contains "www.licter.com" and shows no error. Observed: the field is prefilled with "licter.com" (www. stripped), no error (aria-invalid=false). The card shows "www.licter.com" as the brand name with "licter.com" and the Licter logo under it.

steps.title: Given the user is on the Brand & Country step
steps.expected: The brand search is empty

steps.title: When the user types an address as brand name
steps.expected: The dropdown shows a "Custom Brand" row for "www.licter.com"

steps.title: And the user selects the "Custom Brand" row
steps.expected: The custom brand card "www.licter.com" is displayed with the website field under it

steps.title: Then the website field is prefilled with the typed address
steps.expected: The website field contains "www.licter.com" and shows no error

results.notes: Steps 1-3 OK: dropdown "www.licter.com — Custom Brand" + suggestion "Licter / licter.com"; custom card "www.licter.com" displayed with the website field under it. Step 4: prefilled value = "licter.com" instead of "www.licter.com" (input outlined in red on step3_then). Most likely the GEO-1261 normalization (www. removed, domain kept) applied to the prefill: functionally the prefill works, only the exact value differs. Kept FAIL per the strict exact-value rule; proposed CSV adaptation (to confirm with QA/PO): expect "licter.com" (normalized form of the typed address). Side observation for GEO-1262: the logo is shown at once right after the prefill.

results.title: Changing the website after category discovery clears the discovered categories

steps.title: Given the custom brand "Licter" is selected with the website "licter.com" and a market
steps.expected: "licter.com" is shown under the brand name

steps.title: When the user clicks "Discover Categories"
steps.expected: The Categories step opens with the discovered categories (list noted)

steps.title: And the user clicks Back
steps.expected: Brand & Country shows "Licter" and "licter.com"

steps.title: And the user changes the website and the field loses focus
steps.expected: "onclusive.com" is shown under the brand name, no error

steps.title: Then the categories discovered for the previous website are cleared
steps.expected: Same behaviour as when the brand is changed: the previously discovered categories are not kept

steps.title: When the user clicks "Discover Categories"
steps.expected: The discovery loading screen is displayed again and the Categories step shows the result of the new discovery

results.notes: Reference (today's behaviour, noted first in the same session): Back then Discover Categories with nothing changed -> no loading, no new /discover-categories call, the cached categories are shown again; brand changed (Lictorix Geo -> Lumorix QA) -> loading screen and a new discovery (Quality Assurance Software, Test Automation Tools). Run: C = "Lictorix Geo", W1 = "licter.com" typed then blur -> card shows "Lictorix Geo | licter.com" with the licter logo (www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=licter.com&sz=64). Discover -> Social Listening Software, Audience Intelligence (body entityDomain "licter.com"). Back -> card "Lictorix Geo" + "licter.com", field "licter.com". W2 = "onclusive.com" + blur -> card shows "onclusive.com" with the Onclusive logo, no error. Discover Categories -> "Discovering Categories" loading shown again and a new POST /discover-categories with entityDomain "onclusive.com" -> Location Intelligence Platform, Geospatial Analytics Software. Same behaviour as a brand change: previous categories not kept. OP-6 timing: the reset is applied at the next "Discover Categories" (from Brand & Country the forward stepper steps Categories/Prompts/Review are always aria-disabled, changed or not, so no immediate visible clearing can be observed). step3_then = new categories after rediscovery.
